title: Waiting room
description: cf-waitingroom: admissions, queue, bots, health and cost, from the /__wr/metrics series (docs/monitoring.md).

list.name: Configuration change
list.textFormat: rate, mode, pause or another setting changed

list.name: Coordinator restart
list.textFormat: edge batches lost: deployment or secret change

panels.title: Mode
panels.description: on: normal operation. off: kill switch, everyone goes through. queue_all: every new visitor queues.

panels.title: Admissions
panels.description: Paused: nobody new enters, sessions continue.

panels.title: Queue
panels.description: Open: newcomers enter directly. Queueing: newcomers get a ticket and an admission time.

panels.title: Current wait
panels.description: Wait of a visitor arriving now (cursor lag). 0 without queue. While paused: the wait once admissions resume, the pause itself not included.

panels.title: Waiting visitors
panels.description: Tickets handed out and not yet due.

panels.title: Utilisation
panels.description: Admissions over the last minute ÷ R. Near 100 %, newcomers start to queue.

panels.title: Active users
panels.description: Estimate: sessions seen within D. Reads higher than the real concurrency.

panels.title: Fail-open 5m
panels.description: Last 5 minutes: requests let through because the coordinator was unreachable. Should be 0.

panels.title: Rate R / effective
panels.description: R: configured admissions per minute. Effective: after overbooking (no-shows) and brake.

panels.title: Absence ratio
panels.description: Share of tickets never used (no-shows), sliding window.

panels.title: Brake factor
panels.description: Safety brake on R: 1 = no braking.

panels.title: Isolates
panels.description: Edge isolates that reported in the last minute.

panels.title: Config gen.
panels.description: Configuration generation: increases with each configuration change.

panels.title: Cost / month
panels.description: Projected Durable Object cost beyond the included usage if the last hour lasted 30 days.

panels.title: Admissions per minute
panels.description: Stacked by path (open: leased slots, queue: tickets), against the target R and the effective rate.

panels.title: Queue
panels.description: Waiting visitors (left) and the wait of a visitor arriving now (right; while paused, the wait once admissions resume).

panels.title: Tickets per minute
panels.description: Reserved: places handed out. Redeemed: exchanged for a session. Absent: never used (no-shows).

panels.title: Waiting pages per minute
panels.description: Waiting pages served (a visitor may see several).

panels.title: Load indicators
panels.description: Utilisation, absence ratio and brake factor.

panels.title: Active users (estimate)
panels.description: Sessions seen within D, and whitelisted users counted apart.

panels.title: Provisional cookies per minute
panels.description: Issued on a first visit; claimed when the browser comes back with it. A wide gap means clients that keep no cookie (bots).

panels.title: Whitelist bypass per minute
panels.description: bot: verified bots of the allowed categories. ip: whitelist. header: server-to-server secret. pass: signed links.

panels.title: Reservations refused per minute
panels.description: too_early, pow, cross_site, no_provisional_cookie, turnstile: probable scripts. busy: edge cap reached (retried). full: maxWaitingTickets reached.

panels.title: Tokens refused per minute
panels.description: Session, ticket, signed link or bypass header refused (invalid, expired, revoked); replays are copied tickets.

panels.title: Coordinator errors and fail-open per minute
panels.description: Failed coordinator calls by kind, and requests let through because of them (FAIL_MODE=open).

panels.title: Configuration propagation
panels.description: Edge minimum below the coordinator generation for more than two snapshot TTLs: a change did not reach every isolate.

panels.title: Isolates and leases
panels.description: Isolates that reported in the last minute; slots leased and not reported yet.

panels.title: Coordinator storage
panels.description: Largest SQLite row (limit 2 MB, alert above 1 MB) and tickets in the ledger.

panels.title: Edge batches (per hour)
panels.description: Duplicates: resent after a lost answer, not applied twice. Gaps: lost by a coordinator restart (deployment).

panels.title: Lease slots per minute
panels.description: Slots leased to isolates and what became of them.

panels.title: Coordinator requests per second
panels.description: Billed Durable Object requests by kind. Soft limit about 1,000 req/s per object.

panels.title: SQLite rows written per minute
panels.description: Rows written by the coordinator (billed beyond 50 M per month).

panels.title: Monthly projection
panels.description: Usage if the last hour lasted 30 days (left) and the cost beyond the included usage (right).
